title: Generated PointCloud reactor body recovery profile

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser and writer inventory
selection.reason: The typed DRW_PointCloudDef parser has explicit Reactor and ReactorEx kinds. Their generated bodies contain the bounded class-version field and common object handles, allowing the recovery path to be checked without asserting PointCloud semantic support.

source.mutation: A candidate is admitted only when the corresponding typed PointCloudDef parser rejects it; other object-frame bits are not mutated.
